title: Yunikorn k8shim: When "Trailer" headers are sent by a client, the HTTP server internally uses the header values to…
description: A security vulnerability in the yunikorn-k8shim package exists where the HTTP server uses client-sent "Trailer" headers to populate the request internally. This flaw affects versions prior to 1.9.0-r1 and can cause denial of service. A fix is available in version 1.9.0-r1.
